recommendation.Definition: Baseline weapon-proficiency state for a category before formal proficiency is gained. It does not grant access to category ability trees; those begin at Expertise.

source_support: Weapon Proficiency page 1 publishes Unproficient as the first proficiency level and states that weapon-category ability trees become accessible at Expertise or higher.
entries.rationale: The source explicitly orders Unproficient before Proficient, Expertise, and Mastery and separately states that category ability trees begin at Expertise. Defining Unproficient as the baseline state closes the label without inventing a new attack penalty.
alternatives_considered: Assign a numerical attack penalty; rejected because the source does not state one.
Treat Unproficient as unable to use the weapon at all; rejected because the source does not support a prohibition.

recommendation.Definition: Trained weapon-proficiency state between Unproficient and Expertise. It represents ordinary competent use under the governing weapon rules but does not itself unlock category ability-tree options, which begin at Expertise.

source_support: Weapon Proficiency page 1 publishes Proficient between Unproficient and Expertise and states that weapon-category ability trees become accessible at Expertise or higher.
entries.rationale: The source places Proficient immediately below Expertise and explicitly gates category ability trees at Expertise or higher. This preserves that structure without inventing a bonus.
alternatives_considered: Grant a fixed attack bonus; rejected because no number is published.
Allow Expertise-tree purchases while merely Proficient; rejected because the source explicitly gates those trees at Expertise or higher.

entries.definition: Weapon proficiency level above Expertise that gives access to Mastery-labelled weapon-category abilities. Mastery abilities cost 1,000 XP each, subject to any listed prerequisites.
source_support: Weapon Proficiency, pages 1-2: category examples label abilities at Expertise, Mastery, and Advanced Mastery.
Weapon Proficiency, page 2: Mastery abilities cost 1,000 XP; some abilities have stat or prior-ability prerequisites.

recommendation.Definition: Tier 3 Alchemy ability that improves the Stabilizing Step: gain +2 on Stabilizing Checks. When a Stabilizing Check fails by 5 or less, the potion becomes unstable with reduced shelf life but does not gain an additional harmful side effect from that stabilization failure.

source_support: Alchemy defines a Wisdom (Alchemy) Stabilizing Check at DC 12; success stabilizes the potion, enhanced success increases potency or duration by 25%, and failure makes it unstable with reduced shelf life or side effects.
Alchemy page 14 places Precision Stabilization as the fourth Tier 3 ability but publishes no effect text after its heading.
entries.rationale: Alchemy defines a Wisdom (Alchemy) Stabilizing Check at DC 12, with failure producing reduced shelf life or side effects. Tier 3 already contains Advanced Catalysis (+2 to Catalyzing Checks), so a +2 stabilization specialization is a parallel, bounded recommendation that strengthens reliability without eliminating failure.
alternatives_considered: Automatically succeed on all Stabilizing Checks; rejected as too strong for Tier 3.
Only extend shelf life after a successful check; rejected because the ability name points to precision during stabilization rather than storage alone.
